scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c auto "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:rift-contract && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server && npm run test:rift
